title.en: Knowledgeable retail staff and patient groomers

text.en: Shoppers and pet owners consistently commend the retail team and grooming stylists, singling out team members like Will, Omar, and Ash for their helpful product advice and gentle approach. Reviewers note that staff take time to help customers select appropriate dog foods and supplies, creating a friendly and welcoming neighborhood store atmosphere.

title.en: Gentle handling for shy, nervous dogs

text.en: Clients highlight the calm and considerate care given to sensitive pets during salon visits. Reviewers describe dogs that are usually anxious or squirmy during nail trims and bath appointments settling comfortably under patient handling. Pet parents report that their dogs enjoy visiting the shop and leave calm, relaxed, and cheerful.

title.en: Neat haircuts and efficient grooming appointments

text.en: Owners praise the quality of haircuts, baths, and nail maintenance provided at the Chestnut Hill location. Reviewers remark that doodles and mixed breeds receive neat, even trims completed within promised timeframes. Clients appreciate that appointments run on schedule, allowing them to collect clean, well-groomed pets without long delays.

q.en: What pet supplies are sold at Doggie Style Pets Chestnut Hill?

a.en: The store carries premium dog and cat food, treats, toys, leashes, and daily pet care essentials.

q.en: Does this retail location offer pet grooming services?

a.en: Yes, the shop features a full-service grooming salon offering baths, haircuts, and nail clipping appointments.

q.en: How are anxious dogs handled during grooming visits?

a.en: Reviewers note that stylists such as Omar and Ash work patiently and gently with nervous dogs to keep sessions low-stress.

q.en: How do customers describe product prices and selection?

a.en: Shoppers find the store well-stocked with quality goods, noting that prices reflect premium pet retail selections.
